scope: Active implementation programme. Historical findings retained; per-finding statuses separate implemented and verified scope from remaining acceptance.

priority_definitions.P1: Core task correctness, work preservation, authority, access or repeated navigation/readiness burden; first delivery tranches
priority_definitions.P2: Consistency, discoverability or broader acceptance after dependencies; may move earlier when the representative journey requires it

findings.title: MFA challenge has no matching sign-in continuation
findings.evidence: API returns mfaRequired; lookup/login source has no MFA input branch. Conditional barrier for an enrolled account; not a demonstrated bypass.
findings.proposed_change: Continue the existing issuer challenge with the approved factor/recovery contract. Share a sign-in state controller across entry presentations.
findings.acceptance: Given an enrolled synthetic user, password success opens the existing factor step; invalid/expired/replayed codes fail safely; successful verification alone creates the authenticated continuation. Preserve return context and run auth security gates.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Sidebar navigation loses an unsaved product
findings.evidence: Filled title/description/price, clicked Products, returned Add product: title empty and no confirmation. evidence/product-unsaved-navigation-result.json Fresh Shopify comparison protected a temporary dirty product from sidebar departure, focusing Save; UI input was discarded without creation.
findings.symbol: product editor and shared navigation boundary
findings.proposed_change: Add a shared dirty-navigation contract, scoped recovery draft and explicit discard. Keep the existing pending-save intent distinct from an unsaved form draft.
findings.acceptance: Edit a product, attempt sidebar/Back/store switch/reload: retain work or show a working Stay/Discard choice. Cancel restores focus. After confirmed save the guard clears; another account/store cannot recover the draft.
findings.status: partially implemented; representative Products and Settings journey verified locally
findings.implementation_and_remaining_acceptance: Shared departure decisions, native Back in the current browser, safe explicit discard, acknowledged save-and-leave and scoped ordinary product recovery. Full store-switch/unload/session/device matrix and create-command uncertainty remain open.

findings.title: Page switches wait without sufficient acknowledgement
findings.evidence: User explicitly reported delayed response/page switching on 22 October. Local transitions retained old content before destination or generic skeleton appeared. No exact paint duration claimed.
findings.proposed_change: Provide immediate fixed-geometry clicked-link feedback, a thin indeterminate route strip, stable shell and route-shaped fallback. Profile actual data latency separately. This belongs in the first delivery slice.
findings.acceptance: Keyboard and pointer navigation visibly acknowledge within proposed 100 ms; fast completion does not flicker. Slow/failed/cancelled and rapid A→B→C transitions settle correctly; no old-store content is shown as current. Useful data and preview readiness stay separate.
findings.status: partially implemented and locally verified; remaining acceptance explicit
findings.implementation_and_remaining_acceptance: Installed Next 16.1.6 link/transition signals drive scoped pending cues without changing private prefetch policy.100 ms, rapid supersession, failures and reduced-motion browser timing acceptance remain open.
findings.continuation_result: Continuation: concurrent mandatory shell reads, handle-only request-cache key, truthful router pending cues and safe expired-session return. Normal browser acknowledged pending and protected Products → Settings saves. Exact 100 ms / full rapid supersession, failed/cancelled and multi-browser timing acceptance remain open.

findings.title: Deep-link destination is lost across authentication
findings.evidence: Store layout sends anonymous users to plain lookup; inspected recovery/magic-link links omit context.
findings.proposed_change: Propagate a server-validated return destination through existing login/signup/recovery/select flows, respecting membership and realm.
findings.acceptance: Open a protected product detail while signed out; sign in and return to that authorized detail. Reject external/protocol-relative/encoded hostile destinations; choose a safe store fallback when membership changed.
findings.status: partially implemented and locally verified; remaining acceptance explicit
findings.continuation_result: Continuation: configured-origin return helper and trusted proxy path/query forwarding correct missing/invalid/revoked-cookie redirects. Real revoked valid-format CLI session failed before and passes now; normal browser sign-in returned to Products and General Settings. All MFA/recovery/invite and zero/one/multiple-store branches remain open.

findings.title: Magic-link request reports a successful next step on HTTP rejection
findings.evidence: handleSendMagicLink awaits fetch without checking res.ok; capability defaults disabled.
findings.proposed_change: Check the actual command outcome; preserve anti-enumeration policy while exposing safe delivery/request errors. Keep return context and pending intent. Do not enable the feature as part of the fix.
findings.acceptance: With the approved flag enabled only in tests: rate limit, rejected challenge and network failure do not render an unqualified sent state; retry is bounded; safe inputs and destination survive.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Check-email resend lacks an honest failure path
findings.evidence: Resend ignores status, silently catches failures, resets countdown and supplies literal resend-bypass.
findings.proposed_change: Use the existing challenge/CSRF contract, inspect response status and show permitted retry/error timing. Retain enumeration-safe language.
findings.acceptance: A rejected/rate-limited resend cannot imply delivery or falsely restart successful-send timing. Expired bot evidence obtains a real fresh challenge; no production bypass string is accepted.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Lookup icon-only controls lack explicit names
findings.evidence: Email edit and password visibility controls contain hidden icons without their own aria-label.
findings.proposed_change: Reuse named shared icon buttons; show/hide password has an accurate state and does not clear the field.
findings.acceptance: Assistive technology exposes meaningful edit-email and show/hide-password names; keyboard activation works; password managers and paste remain usable; focus returns after editing email.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Language storage is trusted without enum/storage handling
findings.evidence: Several routes cast localStorage language to Lang.
findings.proposed_change: Centralize supported-language validation and failure-safe preference reading using the existing localization system.
findings.acceptance: Unknown values and blocked storage yield a supported default; long translations, validation and return links remain coherent; no runtime crash or mixed state.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Recovery, invitations and session interruption need composed acceptance
findings.evidence: Routes and existing APIs exist; password reset, staff invitation and expired-session recovery were not exercised in the browser.
findings.proposed_change: Finish acceptance using synthetic accounts and existing issuer/membership boundaries; preserve safe forms after reauthentication.
findings.acceptance: Expired/used reset and invite links show safe recovery. Invite grants only the intended store role; another signed-in account must resolve the mismatch. Session expiry cannot discard a pending product/theme command or silently replay a new one.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Preserve resumable onboarding and clarify enabled formats
findings.evidence: Live step 2 name/subdomain/channel restored on reload; only Online Store enabled. Plan handoff works without purchase.
findings.symbol: draft scope; availability; review and create
findings.proposed_change: Retain the current wizard and server-backed draft; standardize progress/capability language and review summary. Verify race and account scope rather than replace the wizard.
findings.acceptance: Rapid subdomain edits ignore stale availability; unavailable/reserved names block create; duplicate create recovers one site; another account does not see the draft; Back preserves entered fields.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Plan claims and trial handoff need entitlement alignment
findings.evidence: Live plan page has large comparison/promotional blocks and future tiers; no purchase made.
findings.proposed_change: Converge presentation on the existing subscription contract; label current capability, future availability, renewal, GST and trial end clearly without inventing rates.
findings.acceptance: All plan entry routes show the same entitlement/provider-backed amounts and period; failed/unknown activation is distinct from paid; no test triggers a real charge.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Search failure is indistinguishable from no entity matches
findings.evidence: fetchJsonRows returns empty arrays on HTTP errors/transport failures; debounce and abort already exist.
findings.proposed_change: Preserve debounce/abort and return typed result states per entity group; show partial results and a retry option.
findings.acceptance: No-match, denied, timeout and partial failure have different safe UI. Switching store while search is pending cannot leak prior results; retry keeps the query and does not spam requests.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Custom command overlay needs a complete keyboard contract
findings.evidence: Overlay is custom div markup; mount focus and Escape exist. End-to-end dialog containment/combobox semantics not established.
findings.symbol: overlay, result navigation and category controls
findings.proposed_change: Compose existing shared overlay/combobox behavior; provide dialog name, focus containment/restore, active result and meaningful chip/filter actions.
findings.acceptance: Open with shortcut and button; Tab stays in modal, arrows/Enter choose the announced result, Escape returns focus. Background is inert; no dead filter control is exposed.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Disabled Apps route remains advertised as available
findings.evidence: Settings Apps and sales channels led to generic 404; sidebar also contains Add. evidence/local-apps-capability-entry-ax.txt
findings.proposed_change: Use the existing feature/capability decision for both entry and route. Hide unavailable actions or explain them without linking to a known dead destination; keep feature off.
findings.acceptance: With default flag absent, no available CTA ends at a dead Apps route. Direct entry remains fail closed; recover to the originating store. No marketplace or extension execution is activated.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Generic not-found recovery loses store context
findings.evidence: Live app 404 Back to dashboard returned global stores screen.
findings.proposed_change: Provide a safe store-aware recovery action when scope is known, while retaining non-disclosure for unauthorized stores.
findings.acceptance: Known owned-store unavailable route returns to that store or Settings; unauthorized store identifiers reveal no details; global picker remains a secondary option.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Collapsed rail, mobile drawer and flyout parity
findings.evidence: Mobile drawer focused its navigation container and closed after Products resolved; desktop is 220 px. Collapsed rail behavior not verified.
findings.proposed_change: Preserve working drawer ownership/scroll locking. Add collapsed mode only if useful and supported by accessible label/flyout behavior.
findings.acceptance: 390 px pointer/keyboard navigation opens, contains focus, closes on destination/Escape and restores scroll. At 200% text no essential item becomes unreachable. Collapsed children remain named and operable.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Whole-catalog search and sort only operate on the loaded 100
findings.evidence: Product page fetches limit=100 then filters loaded products; BFF pagination already exists.
findings.proposed_change: Push matching/sort/page into existing typed API contracts; persist query state in the URL and show accurate count semantics.
findings.acceptance: Seed more than 100 products; a match outside page one is found, stable sort spans the authorized result, changing filters resets page, Back restores it; unrelated-store products never appear.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Selection and bulk recovery need multi-page acceptance
findings.evidence: One-row selection and explicit count passed; command idempotency/version handling already exists.
findings.proposed_change: Keep explicit-ID/current-page scope and existing stable commands; add all-matching only with an approved population contract.
findings.acceptance: Select, filter, page and change scope without silently expanding selection. Partial failure lists exact affected records; retry recovers original intents; revoked access cannot reuse cached permission.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Product descriptions lack rich editing and safe HTML view
findings.evidence: Live new-product form is a plain Textarea; persistence works.
findings.symbol: Description field and canonical product content contract
findings.proposed_change: Extend an existing suitable rich-content primitive, or one shared UI adapter if absent, with a bounded format, toolbar, paste cleanup, links, source mode and server sanitization. No arbitrary HTML execution.
findings.acceptance: Bold/lists/links and permitted HTML round trip safely; malformed and script/event/javascript URL payloads cannot execute in editor, preview or storefront. Existing plain-text content remains readable and save recovery still works.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: New products start Active with quantity 10
findings.evidence: Live empty form/source show Active and inventory 10; synthetic product was explicitly changed to Draft/0.
findings.symbol: initial product state and publishing section
findings.proposed_change: Choose a deliberate safe default using existing product/publication rules; propose Draft and explicit stock entry. Keep inventory policy and channel publication separately visible.
findings.acceptance: Empty new form cannot imply invented available stock or accidental publication. Preview/review shows actual status/channel/stock; digital or untracked products follow their explicit contract. Record the owner policy decision before changing business defaults.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Uploads and dirty recovery across all record editors
findings.evidence: Theme media controls and product/media flows exist; no upload failure was injected.
findings.symbol: media controls and theme editor controls
findings.proposed_change: Reuse signed upload/media contracts and shared recovery; define queued/uploaded/processing/rejected status, alt text and replacement semantics.
findings.acceptance: Oversized/unsupported media has a useful message; interrupted upload is recoverable; cancelled/replaced media does not overwrite a newer choice; no cross-store asset access; page leave protects meaningful edits.
findings.status: partially implemented for product work protection
findings.implementation_and_remaining_acceptance: Per-tab actor/store/record-scoped unsaved product recovery is distinct from pending edit commands. Other record editors, interrupted uploads and complete asset-security acceptance remain open.

findings.title: Setup says a draft zero-stock product is sellable
findings.evidence: Draft/0 fixture completes Add product described as first sellable item; source primaryComplete uses productsTotal>0.
findings.proposed_change: Separate catalog-created progress from actual launch eligibility using existing server-authoritative rules, or correct the wording to the weaker check. Do not invent a second launch engine.
findings.acceptance: Draft/0 fixture is described truthfully; publishing checks the canonical readiness result. COD configured, online PSP verified, domain reachable and theme customized remain distinct facts.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Setup helper and dashboard show different progress models
findings.evidence: Same fixture: dashboard 4/5, setup assistant 4/6. Their tasks and denominators are not explained.
findings.proposed_change: Share or explicitly distinguish launch blockers versus optional setup tasks; show unavailable checks without counting them complete.
findings.acceptance: Each denominator has a clear meaning; a completed task changes both appropriate surfaces consistently; unavailable backend checks never become success by default.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Analytics catalog/average-order meaning differs from dashboard
findings.evidence: Same fixture: dashboard Products 1 and average —; Analytics Products 0/No products yet and average ₹0. It may use a narrower population; no data-loss claim.
findings.proposed_change: Define population, event/date basis, status inclusion, currency, freshness and undefined averages; expose meaning and consistent labels. Use existing analytics-read contracts.
findings.acceptance: A draft-only catalog and zero-order fixture show explainable counts and an unavailable average rather than a false calculated value; metric drill-through matches its exact period/population and authorization.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Merchant pages expose implementation programme terms
findings.evidence: BackendNeededPane says WS9/Backend requirement; Analytics refers to current endpoint/service fields.
findings.proposed_change: Keep capability honesty but replace engineering terms with plain task impact, current actions and appropriate recovery. Keep internal requirements in docs.
findings.acceptance: No merchant-facing WS9, SKIP NEEDS BACKEND or endpoint-field instructions; unavailable data is not zero and no fake working action appears.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Domain detail/wizard state is not addressable
findings.evidence: Domain overview/connect/detail switch through local useState under the same route; invalid-domain validation/cancel passed.
findings.proposed_change: Represent domain/view/step in existing route/search state with safe ownership resolution; resume only non-secret input and server-confirmed progress.
findings.acceptance: Open a known owned-domain detail directly; reload/Back preserves the selected task; copied link works for another authorized session only. Invalid/unowned domain never leaks status; wizard cancel has a clear return.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: DNS, TLS and domain actions need provider-state acceptance
findings.evidence: Existing detail, health, DNS and SSL components inspected; no real domain connection or purchase performed.
findings.symbol: DNS verification, role and certificate lifecycle
findings.proposed_change: Preserve existing state contracts and independently show DNS ownership, routing, SSL, primary/redirect and last check. No synthetic green health.
findings.acceptance: Use provider-safe fixtures for pending propagation, failed verification, provisioning, active, degraded and retry; copy records accurately; changing primary is idempotent; removal confirms effect and preserves fallback.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Team, billing, payments, tax and security need role-specific acceptance
findings.evidence: Settings routes exist; dangerous provider/security mutations not exercised.
findings.proposed_change: Complete UI truth/permissions using existing APIs. Keep identity factors, finance roles, subscription and storefront readiness separate.
findings.acceptance: Owner/staff/denied roles see only permitted actions; GST/INR and provider mode are accurate; failed/unknown subscription is not active; TOTP enrollment and subsequent sign-in work together; no real charges or credential changes in unattended tests.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Theme release labels blur visibility and draft state
findings.evidence: After save/reload, current hero says LetBuyy Core Unpublished and library badge Published; store remains Private. No Publish button was invoked in the audit.
findings.proposed_change: Expose separate assigned theme, installed instance, saved draft, current release and storefront visibility. Read server lifecycle fields consistently.
findings.acceptance: A private site with a theme release never gives contradictory unqualified labels; Save draft does not imply storefront launch. Reload and return to library display the same release/draft state.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Wide editor keeps controls stacked at 1920 px
findings.evidence: Rendered 1440 and 1920 evidence shows one 300 px outline/properties column; unconditional min-width:761 rule overrides wide layout.
findings.proposed_change: Restore an intentional wide three-pane composition when preview retains sufficient width; preserve stacked layout at constrained widths.
findings.acceptance: At 1920 outline and properties have independent usable rails with no clipped controls; at 1440 choose layout from usable preview minimum; 390 tabs and section→properties handoff stay working.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Draft saved and preview synchronized need distinct status
findings.evidence: Saved acknowledgement appeared with preview Syncing; working iframe later reflected saved heading. Not a demonstrated failed save.
findings.symbol: saveDraft; preview token and iframe readiness
findings.proposed_change: Retain canonical draft acknowledgements; report save and preview states independently, with scoped version/message checks and preview retry.
findings.acceptance: Delayed preview cannot claim synchronized; successful save remains durable during preview failure; stale iframe messages cannot mark a new store/template ready; retry never creates a new save/publication intent.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Section catalog needs stronger discoverability
findings.evidence: Current editor has schema-driven outline/select-and-add; Shopify demonstrated richer categorized previews.
findings.proposed_change: Use a searchable category list and truthful static/live preview in an appropriate dialog/panel over the existing section schema/add command.
findings.acceptance: Find a permitted section by name/category, inspect it, add once and focus its settings; cancel leaves draft untouched; unsupported schema explains the limit; no third-party block seam is activated.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Schema forms, release history and publication recovery need full matrix
findings.evidence: Undo/redo/save/reload passed for Hero heading; library actions and many schema controls exist in source.
findings.proposed_change: Verify current supported schemas and lifecycle operations; preserve actor/version/idempotency security and existing rollback rather than build another release system.
findings.acceptance: Exercise color/font/media/range/rich text/conditional settings, add/move/hide/remove, templates/translations, stale-tab conflict and timeout recovery; publish/rollback affect only acknowledged saved revisions and preserve later drafts.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Theme previews and library actions need consistent presentation
findings.evidence: Rename 640×268/radius12 and illustrative preview with real-preview link inspected; no rename/save or import executed.
findings.proposed_change: Keep existing action contracts; polish art consistency, dialogs, progress and outcome wording. Treat source previews as illustrative until rendered.
findings.acceptance: Rename validates and returns focus; import rejects invalid/path-traversal/oversized packages; duplicate has a stable result; destructive actions explain live dependencies; no success before durable acknowledgement.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Existing plum roles need coordinated chrome and restrained elevation
findings.evidence: Measured header #0A0912, rail/CTA #2C2642; broad header search glow visible; one canonical brandInk ramp exists.
findings.proposed_change: Use the proposed role mapping; reduce ambient gradients/glows in workspaces and align header/rail. No new app-local palette file.
findings.acceptance: Identity, merchant, console and generated consumers retain approved scopes; composed states use the same role palette; no stock-violet accent conflicts or unreadable dark controls; Storybook and real page captures reviewed.
findings.status: implemented shared contract; bounded acceptance recorded
findings.premium_canonical_tranche: Admin palette role mapping implemented; representative three-size composition verified. Identity/console scope retained; final gate evidence in current tranche.

findings.title: Control boundaries, focus and small targets need composed testing
findings.evidence: Current divider #E5E7EB/white is 1.24:1; setup header button measured 18 px wide. This alone does not establish a full criterion failure because cues/spacing vary.
findings.proposed_change: Use adequate essential-boundary roles, inverse focus handling and reliable hit areas; do not darken every decorative divider.
findings.acceptance: Measure actual adjacent colors, keyboard focus and target spacing at all representative surfaces. Normal text meets applicable 4.5:1; essential non-text cues 3:1. Focus is visible on plum and through overlays; no zero-name controls.
findings.status: implemented shared contract; bounded acceptance recorded
findings.premium_canonical_tranche: Essential input boundary and composed focus/save roles tested for contrast; mobile SaveBar target 44px. Full target/device and text-enlargement matrix remains open.

findings.title: Spacing and type need pattern-level assignments
findings.evidence: Canonical 14/20 body, 13/18 table and 24/32 title already fit the product; local pages vary in stacked cards/toolbars.
findings.proposed_change: Apply documented task variants and spacing rhythm; remove redundant headings/nesting; preserve readable operational text. Standardize form recipes with existing BlockStack/InlineStack/Grid/Section and field primitives; document main/aside and Settings compositions rather than add a new form engine.
findings.acceptance: Representative table, form, Settings and editor align on tokens at 390/768/1440/1920; long labels and 200% text wrap without lost actions; no blanket shrink to Shopify compact dimensions.
findings.status: implemented shared contract; bounded acceptance recorded
findings.premium_canonical_tranche: Card/Section, metric/overview/billing widgets, section headings and form spacing canonicalized; existing responsive grids preserved. Additional individual route/state acceptance remains explicit.

findings.title: Empty, no-match, unavailable and denied states need consistent grammar
findings.evidence: Products empty/no-match/clear worked; analytics/backend wording exposes internal terms; shared primitives exist.
findings.proposed_change: Map states to useful actions; coordinate existing first-use art and Lucide roles before generating gaps.
findings.acceptance: First-use offers a valid create path; no-match preserves filters with clear/reset; unavailable offers retry and retained scope; denied offers safe recovery, never a misleading create CTA; artwork has correct semantics.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Fixed trial/save/assistant layers can compete on mobile
findings.evidence: Trial collapse/dismiss exists; user Shopify screenshot illustrated overlapping trial UI. LetBuyy mobile keyboard occlusion not fully exercised.
findings.proposed_change: Define layer/placement rules, reserve footer space and retain truthful server trial dates. Avoid simultaneous obstructing promotions and critical work. Treat dirty form, bulk selection, editor toolbar, selected-object tools and trial promotion as distinct scoped patterns; the contextual SaveBar alone owns form dirty state.
findings.acceptance: At 390 and 200% text with keyboard open, focused fields/actions remain visible; collapse/dismiss works; critical errors outrank promotions; trial values match backend dates, including expiry and timezone boundaries.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Route latency must be profiled separately from loading decoration
findings.evidence: User noticed delay; local old-content transitions observed. Development compilation and automation delays prevent a production speed claim.
findings.symbol: cached auth/store reads; optional store list; products read lifecycle
findings.proposed_change: Instrument existing request boundaries and route usefulness. Inspect optional switcher wait, current cache deduplication, client fetch timing and superseded reads before changing caching.
findings.acceptance: Record warm/cold, local production build, representative 100+ catalog, p50/p95 and failures for click→ack/route/data. Preserve auth revalidation and private cost limits; no global cache of merchant data or broad prefetch workaround.
findings.status: partially implemented and locally verified; remaining acceptance explicit
findings.implementation_and_remaining_acceptance: Mandatory session/current-store authorization retained; the optional switcher streams independently. Production p50/p95 and representative 100+ catalog benchmarks remain open.
findings.continuation_result: Continuation: authenticated production-mode before/final HTTP response baselines recorded (ten warm samples/route) separately from cold development compilation and browser readiness. No consistent overall speedup claimed. Full production workload, 100+ catalog and click-to-paint performance acceptance remain open.

findings.title: Checklist, deterministic defaults and generated proposals need honest labels
findings.evidence: Live setup assistant is a checklist; AI customization/defaults exist. No Sidekick-equivalent agent was tested.
findings.proposed_change: Scope existing helpers to supported tasks; show preview/accept/discard and factual review. Accept edits draft; Save/Publish remain separate.
findings.acceptance: Unavailable AI retains user input and offers manual editing; generated claims require review; cancel has no mutation; stale output cannot target another store; no claim of general agent capability without a real contract.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Complete acceptance across remaining route families and authority boundaries
findings.evidence: 13 identity and 80 merchant page files inventoried; selected core browser paths exercised. Not all records/providers/roles tested.
findings.symbol: route inventory and existing regression suite
findings.proposed_change: Use the route-family matrix to finish direct-detail, permissions, error, recovery, a11y and data-contract acceptance; each untested branch remains marked.
findings.acceptance: Every in-scope beta journey has a real positive control and relevant negative path tied to revision/evidence; frozen/reference routes are not made active merely to increase coverage; skips never count as passes.
findings.status: proposed; not implemented in this audit

findings.title: Header recipes and action metadata need a complete shared contract
findings.evidence: PageHeader exists with adornment and visibility flags; all task contexts share one default geometry. Its default action descriptor has disabled but not loading, while DomainDetailView supplies a custom renderer to wire loading. Passed descriptions/breadcrumbs are hidden unless explicit flags opt in.
findings.proposed_change: Complete explicit index/record/settings/workbench recipes and common action metadata using existing Button and PageHeader. Keep renderAction for real exceptions and readable LetBuyy task titles; do not create parallel headers.
findings.acceptance: Same task identity/actions work across main and Settings at narrow/wide sizes; busy/disabled/unavailable differ, long title and status remain readable, back/description visibility is intentional, and no per-page button clone is needed for ordinary loading.
findings.status: implemented shared contract; bounded acceptance recorded
findings.implementation_and_remaining_acceptance: PageHeader forwards loading/loadingLabel/disabled semantics through Button; the product consumer uses it. Long/localized headers and every route recipe remain open.
findings.premium_canonical_tranche: Explicit index/record/editor/settings/workbench metadata, route icon identities, overflow composition and canonical Button forwarding implemented. Representative responsive headers verified; all translated/provider contexts not certified.

findings.title: Clean SaveBar retains invisible enabled keyboard controls
findings.evidence: On the saved synthetic product without editing, the SaveBar ancestor had opacity0/pointer-events none, but buttons remained enabled/tabIndex0 without hidden/inert. Tab from Tags focused invisible Discard. evidence/canonical-saved-savebar-focus.json
findings.proposed_change: Remove saved-state controls from focus/accessibility/announcements by an appropriate unmount/hidden/inert contract. Preserve needed layout reservation without invisible interactive children. Keep draft/unknown-command protection separate.
findings.acceptance: A clean form has no invisible Save/Discard stop or Unsaved changes announcement. Dirty/busy controls remain reachable; save acknowledgement removes them and restores sensible focus. Main form and Settings callers pass the same keyboard regression.
findings.status: implemented; shared regression and representative browser acceptance passed
findings.implementation_and_remaining_acceptance: Clean SaveBar unmounts; dirty/saving actions remain available; acknowledged clean transition returns focused-bar users to the task heading. Products and Settings share the owner.

findings.title: Grouped section titles lose semantic heading structure
findings.evidence: Section variant grouped renders its title as span; settings-specific card labels also use divs. Standard Section renders h2. Visual grouping therefore has inconsistent heading navigation.
findings.proposed_change: Preserve semantic section headings and association through visual variants, using the existing Section owner and documented settings recipes. Define heading levels/labels deliberately; do not introduce another card/form system.
findings.acceptance: Keyboard/assistive heading navigation finds meaningful groups on equivalent main and Settings forms; grouped styling remains compact; nested headings/unnamed sections are avoided; long localized headings wrap.
findings.status: implemented shared/grouped and static Settings heading semantics; representative browser verification passed
findings.implementation_and_remaining_acceptance: Grouped Section uses h2;37 static Settings/domain labels use h2 with the same CSS. Skeleton placeholders and button labels remain non-headings. Full assistive-device/localization sweep remains open.

findings.title: Page creates a nested main landmark inside AppFrame
findings.evidence: Fresh local Products DOM contains AppFrame main#admin-page-scroll and a nested main from Page; source reproduces that composition. evidence/canonical-current-products-semantics.json
findings.proposed_change: Give the shell one main landmark; compose Page as a non-landmark container inside it while preserving a standalone main option where needed. Audit shared consumers before changing the default.
findings.acceptance: Merchant indexes/forms/Settings contain one appropriate main landmark and skip target; standalone identity/other consumers retain their needed landmark. Scroll ports, sticky positioning, focus and width remain unchanged.
findings.status: implemented shared contract; bounded acceptance recorded
findings.implementation_and_remaining_acceptance: Page defaults to a non-landmark div within the shell, with explicit standalone as=main support. Products/General have one main. Identity/console typechecks passed; broader manual consumer acceptance remains open.
findings.premium_canonical_tranche: Shared Page stays below one shell main; theme library inner main removed. Ordinary route-family measurements verify one main. Theme final measurements recorded separately.
